title: Corrected fixed-head temporal/state-evolution diagnosis
scientific_question: Does the nonzero equal-grid R16_OP residual under corrected QAVG/QEND semantics decrease systematically when only the Layer-ROM research integrator time step is refined, and how much of the R8 residual remains beyond that equal-grid temporal floor?

scope.boundary: fixed zero pressure head at 160 cm, zero top flux

temporal_ladder.integrator: unchanged source-anchored iterative Heun research propagator
temporal_ladder.closure: unchanged standard LARE adjacent-layer internal operator plus BC1 zero-head bottom operator

corrected_observables.QAVG: candidate cumulative-bottom increment over one observation interval divided by 0.001 d versus Reference BOTTOM_OUTWARD_EXCHANGE/0.001 d
corrected_observables.QEND: candidate terminal zero-head Darcy diagnostic versus terminal diagnostic reconstructed from committed Reference bottom-cell theta

adjudication.component_temporal_nonincrease: For a continuous error component, e(dt/2) <= e(dt) + 1e-12 at both refinements. For sign-error counts, counts may not increase.
adjudication.material_R16_temporal_signature: All five causal-core R16_OP components are temporally nonincreasing and at least one causal-core component strictly decreases beyond 1e-12 from dt=1e-4 to dt=2.5e-5.
adjudication.interpretation_if_all_materials: Classify the equal-grid residual as carrying a systematic temporal-integration/state-evolution signature. Do not claim it is fully explained or eliminated unless the residual itself approaches numerical identity.
adjudication.interpretation_if_mixed: Classify temporal contribution as material/component dependent and hold any simple temporal-floor explanation.
adjudication.R8_vs_R16: At each dt and material report componentwise R8 versus R16_OP relations. Do not subtract errors as an additive spatial-closure estimate.
adjudication.finest_core_numerical_identity: All five R16_OP causal-core errors at dt=2.5e-5 d are <= 1e-12 for every material. This is a numerical identity criterion only.

pre_execution_operationalization.material_R16_temporal_signature_applicat: Apply the preregistered five-component nonincrease plus at-least-one-strict-decrease rule at step 1024. Report the same componentwise relations at all earlier frozen checkpoints without allowing them to override the step-1024 decision.
pre_execution_operationalization.sign_count_rule: nonincrease only; sign counts are reported but are not part of the five-component causal core
pre_execution_operationalization.baseline_reproduction: Check both R8 and R16_OP at every frozen checkpoint against the immutable B1HCF per-material corrected result; continuous components <=1e-11 absolute difference and sign counts exact.
pre_execution_operationalization.scientific_effect: NONE: no material, state, partition, dt, closure, response component, or decision direction is changed.
pre_execution_operationalization.alias_note: primary_temporal_horizon_step is an implementation-name alias of decision_checkpoint_step, both frozen at 1024 before any successful B1HCG scientific result.
